meta.name: receiving-code-review
meta.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审慎处理代码审查反馈，验证后再实施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果收到代码审查意见时想先验证再修改
copy.tagline_en: Handle code review feedback with verification before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to verify code review feedback before implementing changes

howto.what: 收到代码评审反馈后,Claude 不会立刻照做,而是先复述需求、对照代码库核实、判断技术上是否站得住,再逐条实现并逐条测试;有不清楚的条目先向你提问。
howto.when: 当你把代码评审意见交给 Claude、让它按建议改代码时接管;反馈含糊或技术上可疑时尤其适用。

say.text: 这是评审反馈,先别改,逐条说说你怎么判断
第 4、5 条我没看懂,先帮我确认要不要照做
评审建议删掉这段旧代码,先查查库里还有没有引用

howto.what_en: When Claude receives code review feedback, it restates the requirement, verifies it against the codebase, judges whether it is technically sound, then implements and tests items one at a time. Unclear items are questioned first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand Claude code review feedback to act on, especially when the feedback is unclear or technically questionable. It verifies before implementing rather than agreeing.

say_en.text: Here's the review feedback - don't change anything yet, walk me through each point
Items 4 and 5 are unclear; confirm them before you touch any code
The reviewer says delete this legacy code - check the codebase for usage first
say_en.note: Greps for usage, may push back
